title: [3.0-Beta5] Screen freezes when initializing Omnipod Eros
symptom: When initializing an Omnipod Eros pod, after pressing 'next' or 'OK' the screen freezes and Android shows a message 'APS does not seem to react. Close or wait?'. The pod eventually starts clicking and completes initialization, but the steps are not smooth.
evidence_quote: After making the necessary changes and coupling the Rileylink prepared the Eros pod. Entering "Activate Pod" and pressing in the bottom on "next" nothing seemed to happen. After some time Android showed a message "APS does not seem to react. Close or wait?"
